༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la gsol ba 'debs pa dang yan lag drug gi lam gyi zab gnad dag bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la gsol ba 'debs pa dang yan lag drug gi lam gyi zab gnad dag bzhugs/

༈ dus kyi 'khor lo la gsol ba 'debs pa/ dpal ldan bla ma thams cad pa/ / dam pa'i shes rab ye shes che/ /'gyur med bde ba lhan cig skyes/ /ma lus 'dod pa'i lha stsol ba/ /dngos po kun kyi khyod la 'dud bgyid na/ /'dren byed g.yo ba'i phyag rgya dman dag la/ /mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin bgyis rdo rje yis/ /sad rmi gnyid 'thug bzhi pa'i 'brog dgon du/ /rnam par 'khyams byed khyab bdag rdo rje bzhi/ /byang chub rnam bzhi'i khyim du bde ba ches/ /dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul rgyal po mgron gnyer shig /mahā su ma stu sarba dza ga taṃ/ rang lo bcu drug pa la'o/ / ༈ yan lag drug gi lam gyi zab gnad ni/ na mo buddha bo dhi satwa kro da ra dza yā/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so sor bsdud pa'i dhu ti yi/ / yas snar srog rlung bsdud par byed/༵ (1) /bsam gtan gyis ni bstan par byed/ (2) /'di ni rtsa lam sbyong byed yin/ ( 3 ) /mtho ris snang ba'i 'jug ngogs las/ /rlung sngags mi phyed yi ge gsum/ /lhun grub rdor bzlas snying kar byed/ (4) /srog thur bsre byed kumbha nya/ /kundhar nang du kha sbyor pa'o/ /srog rtsol srog 'gog lte bar byed/ (5) /'dzin pa 'khor lo drug ka ru/ khams drug thig le srog bcing bas/ /spro bsdu dag pa'i sku sgrub byed/ (6) /stong gzugs phyag rgya'i padma yis/ /mi 'gyur bde ba 'dren par byed/ (7) /phyag rgya gzhan yang thabs yin te/ /de 'dra rjes dran yin par shes/ (8) /de yi stong phrag nyi shu dang*/ /rol brgya'i dkar dmar steng 'og brtsegs/ /rlung thim de nyid bde bar byed/ (9) /dkar dmar brtsegs pa'i dkar dmar ni/ /brtan pa 'dzag bder bcas 'joms byed/ (10) /dhu ti'i sna gnyis gtso che'o/ (11) /ji ltar ngo yis rang nyid mi snang zhing*/ khams zad byed bzhin byang chub sems bcings pas/ /phra rags rdul 'jigs khu rdul tshogs pa 'joms/

/ji srid tshogs pa de srid 'gyur pa yin/ /bde chen kun da'i rgyu las byung mod kyang*/ /bde bas brten pa'i 'brel ba rdzogs tshogs 'jigs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la rdul gyi khams med do/ /tshogs pa zhig na mi 'gyur bde chen thob/ /bskyed rim yan lag bzhi yis rgyud smin byed/ /phra thig bde stong rgyas 'debs gnad du che/ / dang po stong gzugs bar sgrub dhu tir bcug /dbu mar mi 'gyur bcing dang thim pa yis/ /phyag rgya chen po 'grub ces gsal bar shes/ /de dang sbyar ba'i lhan skyes bde stong des/ /don ni 'pho ba gcig thim ma reg par*/ /bden 'dzin nyon mongs sgrib bral byed par go /rlung dang thig le bzhi dang tshogs pa bcom/ /phung khams kun yang mi 'gyur bde chen dang*/ /stong gzugs lus sems zung 'jug ting 'dzin 'di/ /'dzag bde'i bag chags gnyis snang phra mo 'joms/ /gza' skar 'gros dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ /shin du phra ba mdo rgyud gzhan na med/ /de kun lus la dus sbyor rlung la sogs/ /skyes gnas 'jigs srung 'di las rgyas pa su/ /dgos pa sbyang gzhi dang ni lus kyi gnad/ /rtogs phyir nyid yin de shes rim pa gnyis/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i gnad kun bde bar rtogs/ /phyi ma shes pa snga ma rag las shing*/ /dang po'i gnad kun zhib par rtogs sla'i phyir/ /skar rtsis rnams kyang gsal bar gsung pa yin/ /phyi nang nges pa'i lam gyi sgrib spong dang*/ /yon tan bskyed tshul 'bras bu'i gnad kun shes/ /lam dang lam min 'byed la spobs pa rnyed/ /rgyud don ma lus nyams len la dril nas/ /lam gyi srog ni de ltar shes de mkhas/ /de ltar mi shes gza' skar lung ston tsam/ /thugs la bzhag nas rim gnyis la byol dang*/ /lam gnad mi shes blun po glu sgyus mkhan/ /ri mor bris pa'i mar me ngo mtshar che/ /bdag ni log pa'i lam du mi 'gro'o/ /'di ni rang lo bcu dgu pa la brag stod ye shes kyi pho brang du/
kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas so// //bkra shis/ /dge legs 'phel/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 218 -- PAGE 219 -- PAGE 217 -
